missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Напряжение' is the neuter nominative subject of 'чувствовалось'. 'Сильное' is the agreeing neuter adjective, and 'в комнате' sets the scene. A vivid description of mood.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Напряжение' stays nominative as the subject. 'Это' points at a specific instance, and 'не проходило' agrees in neuter past tense. Useful for lasting stress.

missions.phrase: Я чувствую сильное напряжение в плечах.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Напряжение' is the accusative direct object of 'чувствую'; neuter nouns look identical in nominative and accusative. 'В плечах' locates the physical tension.

missions.phrase: Из-за напряжения он не мог спать.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Напряжения' is the genitive form after 'из-за', giving the cause. The clause explains a consequence, a common everyday construction.
Strategic focus: Dative after preposition. 'Напряжению' is the dative form required after 'благодаря', framing the tension as a positive cause. A useful pattern for crediting an outcome.
Strategic focus: Instrumental case. 'Напряжением' is the instrumental form expressing what the air was filled with. 'Наполнен' is the short passive participle, a literary way to set atmosphere.

missions.phrase: Мы говорили о напряжении на работе.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'О напряжении' uses the prepositional form after 'о' to express the topic of conversation. 'На работе' situates the stress. A practical workplace pattern.

missions.phrase: Напряжение между ними росло каждый день.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Напряжение' is the neuter nominative subject of 'росло'. 'Между ними' identifies the parties, and 'каждый день' adds frequency. A tense relational picture.

Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Напряжения' is the nominative plural subject of 'вредят'. 'Постоянные' agrees in the plural, and 'здоровью' is the dative object. A health-themed sentence.
Strategic focus: Accusative object in an infinitive phrase. 'Напряжение' is the accusative object of 'снять'. 'Тихая музыка' is the nominative subject of 'помогает', a soothing everyday tip.
